candidates.name: 2026 non-seasonal subordinate work — Flussi route
candidates.scopeNote: Promotion blocked: financial-requirement evidence is medium confidence — the 2026 Flussi material does not establish a single applicant proof-of-funds amount that can safely be treated as the route universal financial requirement. All other gates pass. Promote only after authoritative applicant-side financial evidence is attached at high confidence.
